    Naming your Cleric

    The Cleric is Aion 2's healer, the person keeping everyone alive. Cleric names tend to be gentle, graceful and faintly holy: soft consonants, lots of vowels and endings like -ine, -iel and -ara. Think Seraphine, Amariel or Celara.

    Asmodian healers don't have to sound sweet. Darker devotional names like Lumena (a nod to Lumiel) or Gravemercy work well. The compound tone pairs faction words with healing themes: Dawnmercy, Halobloom, Moonvigil.

    Quick tips

    • The -iel ending echoes Aion's Empyrean Lords and fits a divine healer.
    • Make it easy to type. Your party will be whispering it a lot.
    • Healing words (grace, mercy, bloom, vigil) make memorable compound names.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What are some pretty Cleric names for Aion 2?

    Seraphine, Amariel, Celara, Lysine and Halobloom are popular styles. Lock the class to Cleric and gender to Female above for more graceful names.

    Is the Cleric the healer class in Aion 2?

    Yes. The Cleric is the main healer, so this generator gives it soft, holy-sounding names.

    How do I use the Cleric name generator?

    The class is already set to Cleric. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, pick a gender and tone, then hit Generate. Click any name to copy it, or ☆ to save it to your shortlist.
